title: Defiance and Non-Compliance
learningOutcomes: Understand the key ideas behind defiance and non compliance and why this topic matters for child development.
Learn practical skills and strategies that help apply defiance and non compliance in everyday parenting situations.
Build confidence using defiance and non compliance to support connection, safety, and positive family routines.

caseworkerSummary: This topic helps parents build practical skills related to defiance and non compliance. It supports safer, more consistent caregiving by improving understanding, strengthening emotional connection, and reducing stress in daily routines. This topic is suitable for parents who need guidance in applying positive parenting strategies and may benefit families working toward stability, reunification, or improved home safety.
